name: Mudkip (and Co.) Save the Entire Universe
source: A year after the events of Mudkip Goes to Walmart then Dies, Mudkip and Protagonist must set out on an adventure to check on Monolith, and determine the fate of the entire universe.
translation: 《水跃鱼去沃尔玛然后死掉》事件一年后，水跃鱼与主人公必须踏上冒险，检查巨石碑，并决定整个宇宙的命运。
